subject: Pilot safety-net credit request — OliveTech
messages:
From: Kate Larson <kate@olivetech.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot wrap-up & ask: two-week extension + evaluation credit

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for running the pilot with us this month — the integration went smoothly and the model latency numbers look promising, but we hit a scaling test in the last run that we need to validate on live traffic. We have a hard deadline to sign off from the platform team by the end of next week.

Would Redwood be open to a two-week trial extension plus a small usage credit (roughly equivalent to $10k of tokens) as a safety-net so we can push another production-like burst without the procurement team blocking the account? Procurement asked that any commitment/discount go through written confirmation.

If you can approve, I can route the updated SOW to procurement (procurement@olivetech.com) and expedite the PO. We’re targeting a Nov 30 decision.

Appreciate the help — Kate

--
Kate Larson
Engineering Manager, OliveTech
kate@olivetech.com
[Attachment: pilot-results-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Hi Kate — thanks for the note and for the context.

I can escalate and get a temporary safety-net credit approved (we typically call this a pilot top-up). I need to confirm the amount and get sign-off from Sales Ops / Finance. I’ve cc’d Marissa (AM) to coordinate and will loop in Ben (Revenue Ops) if we need a formal one-off.

Two quick Qs that help speed approval:
- Can you confirm the expected token/compute estimate for the extra two weeks (ballpark is fine)?
- Is OliveTech comfortable with an addendum to the existing SOW that describes the extension and the single-use credit? Procurement prefers written terms.

I’ll update by Monday EOD PST.

Best,

Sergio — looping Ben for approval.

Recommended path:
- Approve a one-time credit not exceeding $10k (apply as usage credit, expires 14 days after activation).
- Attach a short addendum (SOW addendum + credit terms) and route to Kate and procurement.

Ben — can you confirm we can do this under the pilot allowance and whether legal needs to sign off on the addendum? If so we’ll prep the addendum and a quick DocuSign.
